review: Nice, quiet, comfortable mid-range hotel showing its age a bit Seem to be modernising bit by bit (e.g. electric external window blinds) Bike-friendly with bike storage in basement Very good restaurant with a nice covered terrace for dinner Very good breakfast (except müsli had run out and no refill)

We loved everything!!! If you are looking for someplace to relax ..this is the place for you amongst the olive groves. Santa and Pietro were so informative about the property and any questions we had about the area. Santa took us on an amazing tour of the olives groves and explained how olive oil was made years ago and present time. The pool was lovely and the food incredible. We highly recommend Masseria Valente to anyone who just wants to unwind and relax.
Beautiful place
Great location No laundry, no outdoor garden space, could not find anyone to purchase extra coffee.

The size of the bathroom was great! Was worth giving up a little space in the room for that. Lovely shared balcony. It was clean and organized. There was a big complimentary bottle of water in the shared fridge in the common hallway (we looked around but wouldn't have realized there was one unless we had). There were bagged croissants and pastries if you wanted them as well. Free parking situation at ground level was great. Super close to the hotel (less than 5 min) so good for quick flights out, especially early morning flight. Perfect for our one night stay before flying out early. Close drive to many restaurants and beach. A little shelf by the bed like a nightstand, somewhere to put a phone, etc. At time of booking you need to make people aware that arrival is all online automated only (we were expecting a person to be there similarly to our other bookings) and you need internet access to check in and get into the building so if you don't have access to the internet on your phone other than Wifi, you won't get in. Advise people that there will be videos to get in. Also tell people to text the whats app number not call. Our calls went unanswered. Texts were answered within 10 min or so. Thankfully we ran into a couple leaving the apartment who said they had similar issues and not to call but text. This type of information should be shared prior to booking confirmation. We did see kids peeing on the walls outside the building but inside was clean and smelled clean!

Nice location not in the center of the old city but reasonable walking distance to Mercato Centrale and Sant Lorenzo Church. The person at the reception provided us with the room cards, showed us the room and provided us a city map with some recommendation for restaurants , gelato and important city land marks
Location, cleanest it's was just an amazing experience

The location was perfect for our visit; it was a quick stop before travelling to our next destination (only 1 night). * Great shops and easy to walk around. * Alexandro was fabulous - He greeted us, shared the history of the property (amazing), helped us book a taxi for 5 am the next morning. We're very grateful for his service and the early check-in. As mentioned, the property is very well-maintained; perhaps it's just a matter of personal comfort preferences, especially with our picky teenagers and us being older parents :) We found the beds to be somewhat less comfortable than we had hoped for. If we were staying longer, it might have posed a bit of a challenge.

Great location, 8 min. from Iseo. Simple but very clean. It has all the basics you need. AC, large shower, clean towels and linen, sofa, TV with local channels. Semi hard mattress and thin pillows. Armoire. No fridge. It is family owned, they are lovely. Breakfast was good. No signs as you arrive. A little confusing to find.

Big room, good a/c, coffee, location Poor setup to get into your room. A lot of stairs!! Waited outside on the street for 2 hours trying to reach someone to let us in our room. The telephone number posted outside isn't the right one. Other people staying there finally connected us with owner for passcode.
Loved the people and the location!!! Hard time getting our room to cool down

It is a very beautiful place, about ten fifteen minutes to two interesting town. Very quiet and clean. The host is a nice and helpful person. If I was to go back to Puglia. I would not hesitate and rent at Trulli House. The pool is particularly appreciated. I liked everything at this place
Small, family-run establishment, quiet area. It was a short stay but we would definitely come back given the oportunity. Nothing! It was lovely.
Very friendly staff. Excellent breakfast and dinner package. The facilities are comfortable and modern and they aim to meet every need of travellers.
Amazing place with fabulous views and landscapes!!
Amazing location! Very welcoming and friendly! So clean and well kept!

The apartment was spacious and clean, the host provided some delicious snacks and water for our stay. The location was perfect, only 10 minutes from the port and surrounded by restaurants. It was perfect for our stay. Everything was perfect.

Very loud in the hallways, at all hours. There was a sign to put out if you wanted housekeeping, when we didn’t put it out - the staff still came and knocked on the door in the morning when we were trying to sleep.
Great location, historic property with character, good amenities. No service provided by the staff that we had to communicate with, restrictive requirements to advance city tax via PayPal in advance.

The hotel is very well situated, quiet and calm, and straight next to the main city center street. Staff is super nice and cleanliness is amazing. The panoramic pool on the roof is where you should be!

The staff and service was exceptional, rooftop pool and lounge area stunning and our room was fabulous- outdoor terrace with a hot tub and beautiful lemon and orange trees. Extremely well stock bar with local wines, soft drinks, etc. Five star hotel experience for sure! A little more counter space in the bathroom
Close to main attractions ....you can walk to everywhere Elevator to small
Location. Cleanliness. Room. I would have liked the bathroom in the room.

The place is beautiful, the staff is pleasant, Gabrielle was very helpful and really work hard to make things going A long white road not well maintain 2.2 km, many bees (season ), they asked 2.5 euro for pool towels that why the 8 instead of 9
The breakfast was great. The staff were helpful. Thank you. I would have used the gym if it were open at 6 or 7am. The gym would normally open at 8am, it is too late for me.
Staff were super nice. Place was clean, modern and quaint
Great location. Close to everything in Treviso. Large room, large bathroom. Comfy bed. Water drainage in bathroom sink and shower was poor.
Private room. If you travel with a bigger group you can book 2 rooms or 3 if available.nice Kitchenette. Short walk to old town and sea side . Grocery store downstairs is very convenient None

Hangar Inn is very well located, just a few kilometres from the Rome-Fiumicino airport and accessible through a local cab or bus, both of which have stands at the lower level of Terminal 3 Arrivals. The room was quite large, and included several bottles of water for free, as well as tea and a kettle. A collection of packaged breakfast foods was provided, which will give you a nice start to the day. It is just a 3 minute walk to the nearest supermarket, and there is a mini-fridge in the room which makes it very easy to grab bread or meat, or accommodate an allergy. The Hangar Inn can also help you call a taxi for a specific time, which is very helpful. The hosts were very helpful and friendly as well. While I was unable to see it myself due to timing, the Port of Claudius and Trajan, which is the ancient main harbour of Rome, is close to the Hangar Inn and is one of the most overlooked sets of ruins in the area. This makes Hangar Inn extremely well located for the airport, seeing the city of Fiumicino, and for archaeological sites. I would absolutely recommend the Hangar Inn, and stay again if I had the choice. I liked everything.

Great location with lots of restaurants within walking distance. Breakfast was served in beautiful restored building in the property. Amazing breakfast with lots of sweet and savoury choices, fresh fruit, delicious variety of croissants, and best cappuccino! Pool area had amazing mountain views. Location was a few min drive away from beautiful sandy beach called Spiaggia Playa. We had one room facing the marina which we knew could be extra noisy and on Monday night was especially noisy with motorbikes riding up and down the marina well into 2am. Maybe hotel could supply ear plugs. Would suggest they add more chairs near the pool or even in the courtyard.

The apartment was extremely clean, it had everything that you could ask for if not he would provided for us, and the host was very kind and respectful. He also provided us with complimentary snacks.😍😍😍😍😍😍
Wonderful hotel with a great restaurant and pleasant staff.
Staff friendly. Quiet neighborhood and close to everything.
The view was unbelievable. The road noise, but it was very manageable
Everything from the included snacks and drinks, to the included buffet breakfast. It was well worth it. We also stayed in for dinner and El Porto was superb Nothing much
Very nicely equipped room with a very comfortable bed. 2 bathrooms are available. Kitchen and dining room are great.

Very nice, renovated apartment located just outside of the old, historic centre of Rieti, a stone's throw from the Museo Civico, and quite near to the Velino River. Best for a couple or a couple with one or two small children who will sleep together on the pull-out sofa-bed. The apartment is very comfortable with lots of seating, a great kitchen, and it is easy to keep cool on a hot day. The only downside is the lack of nearby parking for those with a car. This would likely only be an issue for those with traveling with small children or with mobility issues.

Lovely place nestled high above the sea with spectacular views of Taormina. Decent pool and pool deck. Very calm and quiet ..nice ambiance to it. The road up was not so bad at all...only a series of hairpin turns ( but note that you have to ensure you take the route the property tells you to as Google maps can lead you very (very!) wrong depending on your direction of travel...you must ensure you take the road going by the hospital!!). The bathroom had a bit of a smell to it that made my wife uncomfortable...bit of sewer type smell to it. Also - in our room the wifi signal did not work (although it did work fine by the pool).
location dirty, dusty, musty,

Beautiful B&B with all the amenities you could want, an outstanding breakfast, and most exceptionally, a welcoming host passionate about his city and region who welcomes you with a drink of Foggia's local gin and a great explanation of the city's history. A must stay in Foggia. He could teach others how to run a B&B. Nothing. It was a bit of a walk from the train station or a quick taxi, but in a good neighbourhood and walking around is fun anyway.

Roberto provided great instructions on how to find the property and was very receptive to any questions we had. The suite was very nice and comfortable. Everything we needed for our stay was provided. Nothing, it was great

Staff were lovely, helpful kind and attentive. Lia was available in person and via WhatsApp to answer any questions and provide information about nearby activities. Rooms were clean and spacious with well thought out furniture. Parking available. Plan ahead to get to to Ortigia note the walking distance and/or arrange a tuk tuk. Parking was available but shared with public, be sure to remove all belongings from car. Breakfast available for an extra fee.
The staff is super nice and helpful, I will highly recommend this place.

Incredibly kind, attentive and friendly staff. The b & b is located in a beautiful garden that's away from the hustle and bustle of Sorrento itself, but still very accessible. I was greeted with lemonade and chocolate cake upon arrival, breakfast was amazing, and on the one day I had to leave too early for breakfast, I was provided with breakfast "to go". The room was quiet, comfortable, and I slept very well. Highly recommend.
Don't go there even if they pay you to be

We stayed here in early June. It is a lovely little family run place in the hills above Amalfi. The views are amazing, as are the owners and staff. Pros The views are absolutely stunning. I don't think there are better anywhere in Amalfi. The people were fantastic. Luciana and Maurizio in particular were very friendly and accommodating. They offered a very nice breakfast daily, as well as a bar and dinner upon request. Luggage service. Maurizio and his nephews will meet you on arrival and haul your luggage up, and back down when you check out There is only one thing.. The stairs. About 10 minutes up or down. You should definitely be in reasonable shape to tackle them multiple times a day. That said, I am 63 and they didn't kill me.

The room was very clean and well appointed for business or personal travelers. We did enjoy the breakfast which was reasonably priced. There was construction near the hotel which made driving around the area more challenging. From the lobby area you need to take a detour around the building through construction zones to get to the parking as it is on a one way street.

First, Valeria was a wonderful host. Her communication was excellent. She was so kind and generous; we enjoyed talking with her at breakfast. The breakfast was excellent and plentiful. The room was beautiful as was the common space. There was a wonderful restaurant around the corner. Nothing. We loved this place!
The location was great - we could walk everywhere! And the apartment itself was glorious! We do not have anything about it we didn't like.

The room is new, spacious and clean. The beds are comfortable and the location is peaceful. The host is friendly and very helpful. There's a nice and private space outdoor. There are windows in the selling and you can see the sky from the bedroom and bathroom! We loved our stay. Christian gave us great suggestions to visit the Dolomites. The apartment in the first floor has a low selling close to the twin beds, be careful with your head. It would be nice to have a way to warn up food in the room. Christian was really nice warming up our food when we arrived.
Great Location clean hotel good breakfast and friendly staff
Near to metro station and free locker. So old. No elevator. Only 2 bathrooms.

Could not ask for a better location - quiet enough at night but close walk to most things you’d want to see in Palermo. Hosts are wonderful, Ciacci was very easy to reach and quick to answer any questions. Apartment itself was fairly clean, well equipped, and felt bigger than expected and more than enough for a solo traveller. Shower felt like it could be a bit cleaner.

Large very comfortable room with a comfortable bed. Large bathroom with lots of space. Our host Silvia, was incredible! She made our first visit to Rome a wonderful experience! Breakfast each morning was amazing! Wonderful location! I’ll miss staying here and I hope to be back soon!

Helpful hosts. Provided all the guidance asked for. Rooms were clean and neat. The property is at a 10 minutes walking distance from the nearest train / metro station and you can easily reach Roma termini station within 20 minutes. Location of the property is not that great. It is helpful if the hosts can share their whatsapp number with the guests well before their arrival at the property. This will help in better coordination during the checkin process. We had difficulty in reaching the host and had to wait for quite some time outside the property during checkin time
Very nice apartment. Great location. Steps to a small sandy beach and restaurant. Short walk to the old town We had a very enjoyable stay.

I liked the location in the city center and the cleanliness of the room. Super thin wall and doors (you know what ppl are doing 3 rooms next to yours and in the kitchen (common area)). Poor quality of breakfast; 20 cm wide sink; 1 set of towels for 3 days.
Best Breakfast View Everything was perfect

Clean, modern, beautiful space. Large private terrasse with the room. Hosts were lovely and super helpful! Great location. Breakfast is a little early and only about 60-90 minutes. Not a problem. More something to consider.

The house is pretty new! It's is very comfortable and modern. I loved the decoration. I loved the smell. Very clean place. The host Antonella she's is amazing. We even asked her for beach towels and she was kind enough to give them to us to used during our stay. She provided us with clear instructions on how to access the property. I also told her I was doing a late check in and she was fine with it. Great customer service! There is parking available. It's like 15 minutes from Bari downtown if you have a car, it's very convenient. Breakfast is a typical Italian style. Don't expect salty breakfast. The only downside was that the check out was between 10:00 and 10:30 and as I was about to leave the room around 10:10 am there was one of the groomers knocking on the door reminding us about the check out time and that they had to clean the room. Also, I had a text message from Antonella right at 10:00 am and two lost call apparently for the same reason, that we had to leave. I think that if the host would like people to leave right at 10:00 they have to modify the chek out time because if in the website says between 10:00 and 10:30 I'm entitled to leave anytime during that time. Moreover, it wasn't that I had slept through my alarm because I came down for breakfast earlier that morning.
Cozy and clean place, nice & polite staff. Good location, parking, wifi, and above all, nature nearby The Booking.com property address needs to be updated.

It is very modern and bright. It has breakfast which makes it easier when you travel. Also, they are very close to the beach lift to get to the water. What a fantastic day there. I found my pillow hard so my neck started getting sore. I should have asked if they had softer pillows. My mistake.

Big clean rooms with small kitchenette. Very friendly stuff.close to the beach and Canningione. It has a grocery store in the complex if u don't have a meal plan. We didn't like that in order to use the swimming pool we have to use the swimming cap.

Loved the location, room was small but clean and comfortable. The staff were very nice and breakfast was good 👍 Going into the building at night. The whole floor is dark as all lights are off, hallway lights are activated by motion detectors so feels a little creepy.
Good We had a little trouble finding it. There was hardly any toilet paper available in when we arrived.
Great location and client service, I recommend without hesitation ☺️ easy access to majority of attractions and management team very responsive to special needs.
Very clean, large 2 bedroom apartment was perfect for us.
The property was clean close to napoli centrale

We loved the quiet neighborhood to have a restful sleep and proximity to transit to see all the sights of Rome. It was awesome to take a dip in the pool with a bar in the mid afternoon heat! Lots of friendly people. The breakfast was amazing At first I was nervous of all the graffiti in the neighborhood but after staying in Rome a few days graffiti is everywhere and this is actually a very peaceful neighborhood.

Great location with nice view of a small garden. Good variety. Coffee was excellent. Liked the bacon and eggs. Lots of fruit, pastries and really enjoyed the breakfast sandwiches. I have nothing negative to say.

Nothing Rude staff and racist. Yelling at the customers and no hot water due to an issue for hotel end. Better not to take the free shuttle since the staff is so rude. Stay away from this bad hotel. They shout at the customers and this is our first bad behaviour staff during our stay on multiple countries in Europe.
Location close to train station made travel into Venice quick & easy. Helpful staff.

This place is such a gem Very Special , the fact that they have 3 or 4 generations of family working together is a beautiful thing. The nonna still in the kitchen is incredible We felt like we were on our own exclusive beach Such an amazing beautiful spot. The owners and staff are such beautiful people, so warm and friendly and welcoming. We arrived as guests and left as family. Carmela , Guido and their family made us feel so welcome and we had to remind ourselves that we were at a hotel and not at a relative's house. Our favorite place that we discovered through our travels. Grazie Mille prr tutto Carmela e famiglia Siete veramente gente di core A la prossima ❤️
Central location, very clean n very helpful owner! Thank you! Nothing
Good location Could have better description of how to get to parking. Bed was hard
Very nice town and location on main street with much space for several guests. Excellent communication by renters with timely responses to help answer any questions.
Excellent views from our balcony- breakfast was excellent and food/drinks wonderful as well. We did have an ant issue in our room but the manager did comp our parking and bar bill for our stay.
Everything. Nothing

Carolina was helping us with everything and answered all our questions. The room was in the centro so perfect location. La terrazza with la collazione was beautiful. There was a lot of water on the floor after the shower.

on the second floor, room 35. Need to put a ramp of some sort from the main lobby entrance to the elevator, as it was difficult for myself & my wife to lift the large luggage bags up the main stairs to the elevator. Even if it was a temporary one that can be added or removed when needed. It could be on hinges that flip up or down when needed.
The proximity to the water and town. Beautiful views. The included breakfast was one of the best I've had. So much variety
Very complicated check in process

Very quiet, nice high ceilings, comfortable bed, nice selection of complimentary drinks and snacks. Great location. Helpful staff. Good bathroom and shower. Office wasn't always staffed when it should have been. Remember to plug in the bar fridge!

The location is very good in the city center. The service and breakfast are the best parts of the accommodation. The ocean view from the top floor is beautiful. I recommend it. The mattress was a little soft.
Perfect location if you are in the area.. The owners are soooo sweet and kind. Good value for price

The host (Guiseppe) met me at the property on the day of a 24hr national transportation strike which meant I arrived by train at 9am (from Bergamo) instead of 3pm - during the heatwave. He allowed me to check in at 12noon (instead of 3pm) and that was truly appreciated. Not saying he does that for everyone but it demonstrates a quality of host that's become rare. The photos don't do the apartment justice: the decor is truly class and although it's cosy, it's much bigger than expected. It's also dead quiet (for somewhere so central) and very well equipped for a 9-night stay during a heatwave with top quality bed/bath linen and mattress/pillows, a waterfall shower in a large bathroom (by European standards), blackout shutters and excellent AC. The flat is 52 steps up from the front door (3rd floor) but you get used to it and you're rewarded by the light, the high (beamed) ceilings, the balcony, the outlook and the atmosphere. The icing on the cake is the location: so close to the station, the historical centre, grocery stores (Conad, Carrefour and the Central Market), the river (gorgeous promenade) and the direct bus No. 12/13 to Piazzale Michealangelo (the park with the best views of Florence) for 1.70euro is at the corner. Awesome! I highly recommend this gem of a place.

The garden, the sea view, the terrace, the living room. Kitchen was well equipped. Rooms without windows, small bathrooms, small kitchen. Also, with a hefty 300€ administration fee, I would expect the staff to take care of disposing the garbage.
Very nice place in a great location! The host was very helpful and welcoming. There are a lot of great places to eat within a few minutes walk.
Amazing high quality breakfast! I’m still thinking about it!

The staff - Amedeo was incredibly attentive and ensured we were made comfortable from the beginning of our 2 night stay to the very end. Easy & thorough check-in process. Extremely caring about all our needs being met. Maybe next time we will try a sister property in Rome. Monica ensured we had smooth transfer from airport to B&B & back to airport at time of departure. Very dependable. All concerned were met promptly. Generous continental breakfast. Prefer more privacy than having a separate kitchen area. Toilet system wasn't flushing properly. Well stocked with toiletries & plenty of towels.

The staff are amazing especially SARA she is GREAT!!! The location is amazing, a walking distance to everything. the rooms are HUGE beautiful clean. The area is safe and the hotel is safe. The air-condition is perfect. The location coming by car is tricky and narrow streets however the hotel offered a valet parking he took the cars upon our arrival and was very kind and caring in returning it in good condition knowing that the parking fees are not cheap. The place could use more plugs near the bed, it could also need MORE LIGHTING as its dim.
Good apartment, good neighborhood. Close to everything. Parking in Genoa is a challenge

Near the storic center and walking distance to the grotte de catulo. Staff is very friendly specially the 2 ladies at reception. Pizza was delicious. Bedroom was comfortable and quiet. Wish there was a mug for tea instead of paper cups.

Only the location The apartment is located in an old building but the main problem is the mold in the bathroom. As for cleaness I would say needs improvements. There were 2 cups for coffee one small and one large which I did not dare to use. In the listing was advertised 2 wine glasses which were unexisting. The safety deposit box didn't have a key and one day before our departure was replaced... To late for us to use it! The communication with the host... Well kind of hard. Now I would say we are luky she responded to give us the key for checkin! I do not recommend this accommodation.
Exuding natural beauty
Great fancy facilities. Loved the staff. Breakfast was perfect. Great location. Very helpful with my elderly parents. Great also with my young children.

This B&B is run by a family and we met two of their daughters, one to welcome us at night and another for breakfast. Both were extremely welcoming and so sweet. We got caught in a thunderstorm and unfortunately could not come earlier but we so wish we did. My partner and I agreed this was one of our best stays in all of Italy. Bonus points for the cute dog wanting all the pets who is so excited to see you! Relaxing and charming stay in the prosecco hills. I hope to be back soon!
Location, Style, Cleaness and the Inner Garden No complains

Our two night stay there was very pleasant. The staff is extremely friendly and helpful, the room was sparkling clean and the location is unbeatable. The bed was comfortable and there were two different types of pillows. A/C worked perfectly well during our stay (important, since we were there in June).

We were welcomed by a friendly staff member who showed us how to park and enter the apartment. They promptly delivered bedsheets and laundry pods the next day. It was a lovely little apartment with a nice balcony with many things to recommend it. The fold out bed was terribly uncomfortable and so my wife had to sleep in the upper bunk bed all week. I managed to sleep on the bed, but it was very uncomfortable and I had two nights where I hardly got any sleep at all. The place wasn’t very clean many of the dishes and glasses were cracked chipped and most were badly stained or dirty.

This was a handy spot as it was walking distance from the train station. The neighbourhood is a bit busy and the property is on a well-used street, but the door we had to our balcony was very soundproof. Breakfast was amazing - including a coffee bar, and the views from the rooftop deck were so good. I loved the patio! Nothing really - our unit was in a different building from reception but the staff were really helpful and walked us to our building. The elevator didn't work though - so if you have heavy luggage or mobility issues this could be a challenge.
No private toilet, no view, area full with hooligans. Balcony - an old sky shower space
Marco and Moreno served us a very nice breakfast every morning. We really enjoyed relaxing by the pool after a hot day of sightseeing . Nothing we can think of .

Room was comfortable and efficient. Bed was comfortable, shower was great. Small thing but the blackout curtains were not hung right at the center making the whole room look sloppy when in fact it was quite nice. Very good room for Milan visit.
Guiliana was a wonderful host!

Very clean, everything you would need to cook, washing machine, good AC, less than five minutes to the subway station and then 20 minutes to the city center and the host is available. Nothing really. I have family in Italy and will go back next time I visit.
The owners are amazing and took care of us! Loved it. We will be back

We had a lovely stay and would definitely recommend. It had all of the amenities listed and was very spacious. One key note, it is up a rather steep hill if you are walking up. Close enough to walk to the city centre, but far enough that it is quiet and you have a beautiful view of the mountains. Also, there is a free bus pass included with the stay which made it easy to get to different towns. Nothing, our stay was great

- the host cared a lot about my family enjoying the stay, and kept in touch with us - location of the property was fantastic, next to a super market & a 10 minute walk to the center of Lucca - all equipment working perfectly, especially the AC (we went in June) - we were 5 guests, so managing with only one bathroom was tricky at times
The renovated rooms were good, but the older rooms were carpeted and needs to be updated
Hotel was across from train station and short walk to many restaurants, shopping older loooking hotel from the outside and a bit noisy outside
For the price, great service Sha was amazing we felt like we were staying with family
Location with a pool and beach is great. We found the room small as is expected in Europe, however the shower is very tiny. Difficult to get in and out and bending down is impossible.

Location was very good. Room was very nice. More of a room than apt. We needed two bed so a little tight with wall bed opened. Host was nice, not much interaction. A good place to stay for one night A bit small but beautifully decorated

Nice modern hotel. High ceilings. We were given a smaller room than I paid for because the grumpy man at the counter considered that we did not need bigger! Even if I paid to have a living room space in my room, separate from the bedroom. He gave us a double regular room. No iron in the room either.

Il Gelso is a rustic vacation spot. The staff are kind and helpful. Francesca was a wonderful host and helped us throughout our stay! The room was large, air conditioned and tidy. The beach is a 10 minute walk with many stairs to access. Bring watershoes to navigate the rocks, there are mattresses for rental. It can be difficult to get around the island at times so plan ahead and book a taxi from the ferry/hydrofoil. Plan for a more rustic family stay! Give yourself extra time to get around the island.

The hotel's location is perfect as it's right in the heart of Rome's centre so it's only about a 30-40 min walk to anywhere you want to go. We found it pretty quiet at night and didn't hear any noise from the street below. The breakfast had a decent selection. The room was spacious and clean, and the staff were really nice and accommodating. The bed was pretty uncomfortable. I had to sleep on top of the comforter I found in the armoire for more cushion, which did help. The hotel walls are pretty thin so you could hear other guests coming and going. The coffee wasn't that great and although the breakfast had plenty to offer, the hot breakfast was disappointing.
Location and staff friendliness The size of the room, especially the bathroom.

I had a wonderful stay. The rooms were spotless, comfortable, and well-equipped with all the essentials. The staff were warm, professional, and always ready to help with a smile. The location was convenient, and the facilities made the stay even more enjoyable. Everything from check-in to check-out was smooth and pleasant. Highly recommend for a comfortable and memorable stay!
The breakfast was amazing. Staff was friendly. Room was great. Need better communication regarding evening activities . Other than that we had a great time.
Our Host Francesco was very attentive even though we didn't speak the same language. Great Location. Room on the smaller side, but nothing to complain about. It's still cute and homely.

Easy to get to from airport using bus 5. It costs 10 Euros. Easy using bus 5 to get to Venice for 1.5 Euros. Shuttle to airport available for 8 Euros. Restaurant in the hotel, good food, large portions and nice variety. Clean rooms. No English Tv. Stations available on cable.
Very kind owner's made me feel at home, very helpful , excellent food and great location
Clean, relaxing and the pool was great to relax when you just wanted to cool off or rest. Not much. Everything was to our liking.

did not stay at the location. Advertised as having internet. When i got there there was no internet and i needed it to conduct communication with CDN government to updated my travel documents. I left within 1/2 hour and requested my money back. Accessibility to close by restaurants and bars.

Carlo the host was exceptional with getting us settled in the hotel. The transfer from Catania was a problem with the taxi dropping us in the wrong spot. Carlo set him straight. Location was great. Very clean. Carlo was very helpful Taxi wasn't good for my 83 year old mom

This is a super clean, large one-bedroom apartment that puts you right on top of everything you want to see in Genova after a 12 minute walk from Principe station. Transit is plentiful but we hardly needed it. It's easy to access the building and apartment with the provided code. The kitchen was set up with everything we needed for our breakfast and dinners. There is a small balcony overlooking the back of the building where we dined al fresco - very nice. The host - Maura - is terrific to communicate with: prompt to reply, helpful, professional and - while we didn't meet in person as we were so busy sight-seeing - you can tell from the 'tone' of the messages that she is a very nice person. We hope to return and stay here again and we very much recommend this apartment for your stay in Genova!!

Location was very good - its in the city center, very close to the Duomo and Galleria Emanuelle. The unit is easy to get in and out of because there are no keys, its all digital. The place was tidy upon arrival and instruction were clear. Lots of great little restaurants close by The place smells strongly of cigarette smoke—it’s like walking into an ashtray. The digital lock on the front door can be a bit tricky to use. One of the bedrooms is in the cellar, the one with the arched brick ceiling, and it was extremely damp. There is a dehumidifier, but it was turned off, and the room felt wet and musty. The unit is quite old and doesn’t always start up properly—we had to fiddle with it for a couple of hours to get it working, which is the last thing you want to deal with after a long day of travel. When we arrived, none of the AC units were on, and the entire place was sweltering. The remote for the downstairs AC was broken, but after a while we figured out we could open the panel and use the 'emergency off' button just to get it running. It functioned at a basic level, and to their credit, the host did replace the remote the next day. After a few hours of the AC and de-humidifier running, the cellar bedroom was very comfortable to sleep in. There was also no hot water in the ensuite bathroom of the cellar bedroom. We were told the hot water tank had been turned off due to a leak, but could be turned back on before each shower—then you have to wait for the tank to refill. Not ideal. Connectivity is another issue. There’s no Wi-Fi signal in the cellar at all because the modem is on the second floor, and there’s zero cell reception down there—it’s a complete dead zone. You have to go upstairs just to use your phone. To top it off, there was visible black mould on one of the walls in the main floor bathroom. While the price was relatively affordable given the location, I would not recommend this place. Too many basic issues that made the stay uncomfortable.

Location Pressure to forward passport and other ID prior to arrival. Did not comply as this is opposed to Booking.com stated policy. Created friction and multiple attempts for compliance. Dishes dirty, sheets and towels found stained. Infested with tiny ants, primarily in bathroom. Safe found locked and unable to utilize.

Excellent central location in the very middle of Cortina (right opposite church which thankfully did not have bells ringing all hours) Very friendly and helpful staff Very tastefully renovated hotel with nice wood throughout and comfortable room with modern bathroom Bike-friendly with separate garage for bike storage Extraordinarily good breakfast A little bit pricy (but realize it was the middle of the main tourist season)
Clean, spacious and beautiful room. Lovely breakfast. Excellent location and friendly and helpful hosts.

We needed a base for our last two nights in Sicily in order to be at Catania Airport to fly home on a 6 am flight. MicHouse is a lovely real home in a historic building close to (but not quite in) the tourist centre. The hosts were so great. We wanted to get rid of our rental car and Luca picked us up at the car drop and brought us to MicHouse, and he and Laura showed us the place. It's awesome. The ceilings!!! The terrasse! The kitchen is big, with a table suitable for a family, and a living room! (Our other vacation rentals in Sicily have been lovely, too, but comparatively very small. For Canadians, this felt like luxuriously roomy for our family of 4.) Luca and Laura were lovely and welcoming, and very responsive (we accidentally locked ourselves out once and Luca was there within minutes). There is a good gelateria just steps away, and shops close by. We walked down to the fish market, piazza del duomo etc. Not a bad walk (hot of course). The only thing is that because this is more "tourist centre adjacent", the first part of the walk is through a real neighbourhood. That is to say, it's a little "gritty". We like that just fine, but some people may be less excited. We were glad to have ditched the car...parking was available, but, as you know if you have driven in places like Sicily or Dominican Republic as a North American, it's just not obvious how to get in and out and it can at times be heart-stopping. One more great thing...the washing machine and clothesline. So great when travelling. It was all great.
Location and breakfast was good The room. Rather dated. Hairdryer heated up too much! Toilet paper holder was in back of toilet !!

Great location and decent amount of room. The host was there upon arrival. She gave us some good information about the area. Coffee was provided and the fridge was great to have for small items. It isn't fancy but for exploring room it suited our needs.

A most welcoming and authentic Venetian experience. Well located with its own access from the river so convenient for water taxi pick up / drop off. The staff are hospitable and highly professional. We will be back very soon. It’s all positive.

Fantastic location - close to many highly rated restaurants, dessert shops, a supermarket, Metro, and within walking distance to the main cultural sites. Noise level from other guests and outside were minimal. Owner was friendly and readily available by phone. Shower was a little small although the bathroom itself was an adequate size.
Amazing location! The host, Danilo, was very welcoming and helpful with information about the area. The room was clean and spacious with a cute little balcony.

Service was outstanding (Frederico was so kind)! Room was very pretty and view from the room balcony was breathtaking. Also, the bathroom was quite small, shower was very tight with hardly and room to move around or even open the shower door. Even the room was a bit small overall.
great location and friendly staff everything good
Everything was amazing. The staff was very friendly and helpful. They gave us great tips for dining etc. The Albergo is in a great location to explore Verona. The breakfast was great too.

- very clean - nice location - friendly staff - facilities could use some renovations, in our first room; the AC wasn't working the staff were cooperative and gave us another room where the AC was working but very loud

Comfortable bed and a good breakfast. Location and transport.

Very accommodating and helpful, even offered to carry my bags which was unnecessary. cute kitchen with everything, AC was strong . Wish I stayed a few more days. wifi a bit weak but still fine as the room was probably furthest
Beautiful place! So clean. Surrounded by nature . Would go back again To get to the property it was a litlle challenging! You need a good car ! Other than that everything was great.

The location was absolutely perfect. Staying in a Trullo was a wonderful experience. We couldn’t have asked for a more beautiful place. The breakfast was simple but the coffee was excellent. We will never forget their kindness and will definitely recommend their place to others. We loved everything at Terrazze sulla Valle.

The apartment is super cute and the communications are smooth despite being contactless. The location is perfect. The overall place would benefit some renovations, especially the bathroom. Everything works but the comfort is not top.

The finest friendliest staff you will ever meet !!! Very helpful and kind, free diner and breakfast with outstanding views of the ocean form the room and pool , a must!!!

We LOVED this absolutely gorgeous hotel in Taormina! And I mean gorgeous! The rooms were great and had doors that opened onto a beautiful terrace overlooking the Mediterranean, with table/chairs/loungers for each room. Very well-tended gardens all around. The interiors were decorated in "old" Italian style, lots of character. There is a lounge for drinks with high ceilings and Italian furniture, beautifully decorated. And I can't say enough about the buffet breakfast. Absolutely fantastic with so much choice, everything excellent. Cheese, salads, juices, baked goods, sweets, eggs, hot dishes, even had tiramisu! Every morning we were there (3), the breakfast offerings were slightly different which was also great. And of course, when you sit down someone comes to get your cappuccino order right away! The breakfast room had soaring ceilings and huge windows, and an adjoining sunny terrace where we ate, all with an uninterrupted view to the sea. The hotel (and all of Taormina) is built on a steep hillside, so the roads are pretty windy and steep. Bel Soggiorno is not quite in Taormina proper (which is a good thing because it can be packed with people), but it is only a short staircase up to the main part of town. You really can't get more picturesque than this place! I'd recommend staying at this well-tended hotel! It was all good!

Overall this was our last hotel during our time in Italy and it left us with a wonderful impression. Great location close to the train station. Front desk staff and housekeeping staff friendly and helpful. Thank you and hope to return again soon. I would have preferred breakfast included , didn’t know that was an option. Other than that, no complaints.

Ultimately, I had to let my bank handle it after my trip ended as I didn't want to risk my reservation being impacted before arrival. The lack of professionalism in this case ended up casting a negative shadow across the whole experience, therefore I can't recommend staying.

We spent a month in Italy, beginning and ending in Venice. Of course, if you are visiting Venice you should stay in the historical heart of it, which we did at the beginning of our trip. However, for our last 2 nights in Italy, we stayed at Ca Tessera because our flight home was due to leave at 6:00 am, meaning we would have to get to the airport by about 3:30 AM. So instead of staying in Venice for our last 2 nights, we decided to stay out near the airport which was a VERY GOOD decision. This hotel was excellent for this purpose! The facilities were great, it was quiet, very friendly staff and it was quite picturesque too. And I think they know that most people who stay here do so because they have to get to the airport (there are several hotels in the area). So they have an excellent shuttle service that will get you to and from the airport any time (book it the day before at the front desk), only 10-15 minutes away. And they had some breakfast items ready that early too. Also, because we did have 1 full day left in Italy, we wanted to go into Venice. It was VERY easy to catch a nearby bus that zoomed right to Venice, and it was easy and quick to get back to the hotel. Not complicated. And the staff can tell you how to do it easily. So if you are flying out of Venice airport and want to stay only a 10 minute shuttle ride away, this is a very good choice! Might have been nice to have drinks available to purchase on site, since they do have a very nice lounge and outdoor sitting space.

The place has really "cute" decorating (everything matches) yet very awkward to live in and not functional for people who travel (we need flat surfaces to put our stuff on: the only super small shelf in the bathroom can fit a toothpaste, brush + the provided plastic cup and soap (need a proper sized shelf/vanity/something flat and waterproof near the sink); the narrow table for coffee/tea/cups is way too narrow to add anything else (the 'nespresso machine has to be on an angle); only small/short stool (nowhere to lay down clothes or for a grown man to sit properly). The bed is really where you have to sit and ideally not just 3 fat/ puffy bed pillows (both of us got a sore neck). The " cute" black bar fridge compressor turns on/off loudly (irritating to sleep with) and as others have indicated, the bathroom fan noise level which goes on with the light can 'wake the dead'. No glasses - only 2 coffee cups/saucers and very small paper cups (horrible to drink wine/beer from:) There are 2 small nightstands - small again - as is the area to hang clothes (the hangars have to go on an angle to fit). So all in all, it is an awkward space to stay in even with small travel bags (they of course end up on the floor)- at one point I used the toilet lid and bidet for holding my coffee! Oh, 6+ coffee pods yet 3 fake creamers for 2 nights:( Even if the owner got 2 folding luggage racks, that would assist in staying organized. Yes, the shower is normal-Italy size yet tough for a real-sized person to have a good shower. (BTW run both the shower heads before you get in to warm the water in all the pipes). The fact that the owner insists on a 2 night MIN stay meant we were committed or lost money.

The view from the room was everything!!! So close to bus to city center. Elevator which was sooooo necessary with bags in 30 degree heat. Also great AC. Very nice host who met us and gave the keys. Awesome stay.

For travelling with a car, it was nice to find a rental that included parking that was not on the street. The location was a 20 minute walk to the Centro Storico location of the town. The area of the rental was in middle of some very good restaurants, gelato bars and pizzerias. You had everything you would need outside your door. The apartment has a common area for breakfast and lounging area with lots of tourist information at hand. Check in and communication with the host was seamless. Beds could have been a bit more comfortable but everybody has there own comfort level. Just a little far out from the centro Lecce, but we just walked, if your jumped on a bus it would be a very quick trip.

The staff went above and beyond. They were so welcoming and accommodating. They really wanted our stay to be special. The food was incredible, the best we’ve had in Italy to date. Over all a 11/10 experience!

In the Navigli district — A short walk to many restaurants and bars. Quiet but dark. Honest Review – 3/5 I don’t usually write reviews — but felt this was important to share. It's only fair to help others get a better sense of what they're paying for. We’re a family of four (traveling with two children under 12), Location: In the Navigli district — great for nightlife and canal-side restaurants. However, if your interests are visiting Milan’s main sights (Duomo, Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, Sforzesco Castle, or the main shopping area), staying closer to the city center is more practical. The metro is approximately 20-minute walk away. While the tram is nearby, it wasn’t very convenient due to ongoing construction and street closures. The Unit (2-Bedroom Loft): The unit has A/C, but it’s placed too low to cool the loft area where the beds are. As heat rises, sleeping upstairs was uncomfortably hot and stuffy. A fan was placed in 1 bedroom but wasn't much help. The furnishings and bedding are all IKEA. Sheets were rough, and the only blanket provided was a thick wool-blend — far too heavy for July. Comfort & Amenities: All pillows were firm foam — not ideal for long stays or for those who prefer softer options. A mix would be appreciated. No hooks anywhere — Nowhere to hang your purse, sweater, or towels. Bathroom amenities--hand soap made available but seemed like shampoo/body wash was left from a previous guest. No tissues or Kleenex provided. Kitchen was stocked with basic cookware, plates, and utensils, but lacked a microwave and dishwasher. Even for simple reheats, you need to use the stove. It was quiet —However, the overall vibe inside the unit could feel a bit eerie at times, especially with kids; something to keep in mind. Overall: This place has potential, but needs improvement in comfort, layout and attention to detail. For now, rating it a 3 out of 5.

Also, when planning to swim at the beach, make sure that the public beach is where there are no umbrellas and lounge chairs, as those belong to the reserved/private hotels aligned by the beach. The public beach section is just down the road from the B&B. Furthermore, the breakfast was worth it. The fruits were fresh, pastries tasted amazing, coffee was served very kindly when asked. The dining room is outside and it's very chic and clean. ADVISE: BRING COMFY SHOES, if you plan to climb/hike the hill. Lastly, I would like to thank all the staff members for such a lovely stay. The place is nicely decorated. On June 27, 2025, I checked into Le Terrazze Suites in Bari, Italy. Upon arriving in the afternoon, I discovered that the air conditioning in the room was malfunctioning. Although it was set to 15°C, the room temperature remained close to 30°C, and the air being circulated was hot. This extreme heat made it very difficult for my family and me to rest properly—we were sweating all night and could barely sleep. I immediately reported the issue to Le Terrazze Suites via WhatsApp. They initially claimed that the system had “crashed” because we had turned the panel on and off multiple times (which we did not do). They attempted a remote reset, but the temperature did not drop. They promised that a technician would be sent the following day to investigate and offered to move us to another room if the problem couldn’t be resolved. In the early morning of June 28, I provided photo evidence showing that the temperature was still between 28°C and 29.8°C. I formally requested action based on Articles 1575 and 1578 of the Italian Civil Code, which guarantee guests a safe and comfortable accommodation environment. I asked Le Terrazze Suites to either: • Urgently fix or replace the air conditioning or offer another room; • Or provide a partial refund or discount due to the substandard service. Le Terrazze Suites did offer an alternative room, but it was only half the size of the original room and far too cramped to meet our needs, so I declined. As Le Terrazze Suites failed to provide an acceptable level of comfort during our stay, I explicitly requested a partial refund on the second day. They agreed to refund 50% as compensation, but I have not received it to this day. Booking.com informed me that the property does not respond to calls or messages. The host has since deleted me from WhatsApp, but I have kept all photos, videos, and call records as proof. Il 27 giugno 2025 ho effettuato il check-in presso Le Terrazze Suites a Bari, in Italia.

The staff were beyond friendly and informative, everything from where to eat, how to get places and things to do. Thanks to you all. Nothing. Loved it all.
Spacious suite, nice pool , most of the staff were nice, food great and excellent wine. A nice assortment for breakfast. The grounds are beautiful. some know little English.

The hotel itself was beautiful for its historical beauty and significance which is what I mainly booked it for. Beds uncomfy, mildew spotted pillows, shower didn’t work and no warm water, window screwed shut and broken, flat and few pillows, no air con that worked, very loud from the street beside it/ hard to sleep, additional charges (2$/ night) when you check out, no shorts allowed to be worn despite 32 degree weather. Fountains were dirty and had no water, not like photos

Everything was great. The host was friendly, responsive, and provided helpful recommendations. The room was comfortable, and the upstairs patio was very nice. It was a short 6-minute walk to the bus station, making it easy to get around. Lots of great restaurants nearby. The location was excellent, and check-in times were flexible.

Beautiful beach and pools Kids Club employees fun with kids Limited food options Staff is not that friendly to foreigners Only reception was helpful Rooms were not getting clean until I asked. It seems they forgot The resort is big with no buggy service in the summer, which is very exhausting but except for a small distance to the beach
Friendly staff, great location, cool and clean, perfect for young travellers travelling alone or with friends! There are no curtains on the side of the beds, which makes it harder to get privacy…

Great location, and a beautiful city. I found it a bit too busy and touristy. If yoy are wanting a mire serene Tuscany stay, I would try somewhere else. The hotel itself was great, very large room and I recommend getting a room with the terrace - amazing view watching the moon come up! It was clean, except the bathroom could have used a bit more cleaning. The restaurant is great for breakfast, but expensive for dinner, but there are many options to eat in the city. Overnight parking was fine, only 15 euros. The shower leaked everywhere! I think the shower head is in the wrong location for the tiny shower, but the water was nice and hot!

Very clean, comfortble bed, quiet. Modern compact kitchen and bathroom. Very cramped, low ceilings because of location in the roof, especially if you are tall. Stairs to 6th floor difficult with luggage. No-one there on arrival to help with a problem with the automatic locking system. Nowhere to sit after walking around the city all day - either on the bed or a kitchen stool. No property or city information to help in navigating the stay for newcomer to the city.
Everything is perfect 👌 Nothing

We loved our stay , it was one of the best guest house wéve tried, the room was spacious and clean, the instructions were received before our arrival and were clear, the area was great just 6 mns walk to the vatican, and of course Georgia, she was so welcomming and helpful , always smiling and answering all our questions, for sure we will be back 😍
The staff is helpful, the location is amazing and the room is clean.

Location was so convenient as we flew in late. Very close to the airport, but very quiet. Bus stops in front of the property. The bus goes right to the entrance to the old city. Very clean. Amenities are modern and work well. My communication with the owner was very pleasant and timely.
Owner was very welcoming and made sure we had everything we needed. View from balcony is exceptionnal! Overall very happy with our stay.
The staffs are very helpful. The trouble of the lock of the door made us very anxious and exhausted. Hopefully it can be fixed soon.

Beautiful converted castle! It is such an experience staying here. Parking was easy to find on the street, and breakfast every morning was great. Our AC unit was sputtering cold water in our room throughout our stay, but it worked (which was a blessing). Otherwise, the vibe of the castle generally felt somewhat off. Massive unused rooms, bar closing at 8pm, etc. made for the shared spaces to feel empty and soulless.

Good location.plenty of free parking. Free Breakfast was excellent. Rooms were very dated, floors were dirty, moldy bathrooms.mini fridge was unplugged, dirty with pooled water and could not be plugged in due to different plug with no adapter. Very hard beds. Dinner at the restaurant was inedible, perhaps the worst dinner in Italy. Pasta was overly salty, pork entre was served cold. Do not eat here.

The view from our balcony was fantastic. Unique experience staying in a stoned house. The house is only 1.2 km to the historical town of Montepulciano. Breakfast was good. The owner offered service transport to bus station and or restaurants. None.
Location is good. I recommend to complete all documentation process before you leave your country to have everything ready when you arrive
Loved the location right on the lagoon but far enough away from the main crowds. Excellent breakfast with lots of choices. The staff were very friendly and helpful.
Outdoor patio with million dollar view Only 2 teaspoons for cutlery. Corkscrew was broken. A knife for cutting bread, or a fork would have been helpful.

The outstanding service really made for a great stay. Alba is a #1 hostess who went above and beyond. Breakfast was exceptional and view from the restaraunt the same. Room was very clean and functional with great a/c. Comfy beds, pillows and such. A great experience I would recommend to anyone.

Location was great. The young Reception lady was awesome and helpful. The beds were great. More water bottles should have been provided for a 4-person room. Shower pressure was weak. Fridge wasnt very cold. Maybe for the future, electronic cards for opening doors would be easier than carrying 4 different keys.

We booked two rooms because we are a family of five. The rooms were clean. The bed was comfortable. Bathroom was fine in our room, small in the other room. Breakfast was OK. The subway was nearby and very useful. The area is not the greatest, so avoid going out at night. The layout of the rooms could use improvement. There were no drawers, no chairs, and the nightstand was a tiny shelf that barely fit your phone. Each room had a different sized safe. Ours could barely fit our passports. The AC was what stressed us out. My kids had to change rooms once because of it but it was the same thing in all our rooms. It can be hot, or really cold, and regulating it was frustrating.

The location was fantastic - right in the old town and yet surprisingly quiet. The windows are really high quality and block out the noise really well. The apartment has everything you need and Carola is incredibly responsive with any questions. The parking was also really easy - just out the back door and two minutes to a free parking lot. Highly recommend - quick access to Montalcino, Pienza, Montepulciano and other lovely towns in the heart of Tuscany. Nothing; it was everything we wanted.
Location is closed to train stations and room is spacious and clean. staff is helpful and responsive. Air conditioning is not cold enough

The location of this place is very good; just a 15 minute walk from the train station and very central. The view from the apartment (apt. 5) was gorgeous, that was definitely my favourite part! The facilities were very good. The kitchenette was well stocked for cooking, including a Nespresso machine. Check in was not very straight forward. Was not easy to communicate directly with the property manager. Lack of response when messaged through booking.com. TV remote did not have battery. Shower was mostly cold and did not heat up well. Water pressure for hot water was not good.

Very nice location. The owners are friendly and present. The appartment is clean and well kept. Could feel a bit tight the entrance directly on the kitchen. The rooms upstairs are big and comfy. Just the entrance and kitchen area are a bit on the small side and tight..
Better then I expected. Loved everything about this hotel. Breakfast was great, room, service and staff exceptional.
Very clean, prompt reply from host, comfortable. Location is deceiving on booking map, as it does not overlook the water/ beach.

We had a phenomenal stay. The room was extremely clean, and the location was absolutely perfect. We were a short 6-minute walk from the train station, and the train to the airport was about 10 minutes. The train to the airport leaves fairly frequently too, so there are lot of departure time options. The staff was very friendly. We found the mattress to be slightly too firm for our liking, but overall, we still had a great sleep.

Melania was very friendly and helpful, she even made sure to bring our luggage to our suite when they were delivered while we were out on our tour. The hotel is very cozy and comfy and couldn't ask for a better location!

​What a fantastic stay! My wife and I spent one night at this apartment in Rome, and it was absolutely amazing. It's clear that Simona, our host, takes great pride in her property. The apartment was immaculately clean and beautifully decorated, with a charming, rustic Italian feel. ​Simona herself was incredibly helpful and kind. She went above and beyond to make our trip special, even assisting me in planning a surprise for my wife. ​The location simply couldn't be better. We were just a block away from the Pantheon, which made it so easy to explore one of Rome's most famous landmarks. The area around the apartment is bustling with life, with endless number of incredible restaurants, cafes, and gelaterias right on the doorstep. It truly felt like we were at the heart of everything. If we ever come back to Rome, we will undoubtedly stay at Simona's apartment. That I only stayed one night.
Everything was provided for simple apartment living. Dino the host was friendly, prompt and very helpful.

The staff are great, the room was the perfect size for my needs and the breakfast was lovely. The walls are fairly thin and I was kept awake by the trains outside my window and a fellow in the next room who was having a breathing problem of some sort.

Fabulous. Wonderful hotel in a beautiful village. Great experience in the Dolomites. We had a fabulous room. The owners and staff were exceptional, so welcoming. The food was unbelievable (and I do recommend that you eat here). Loved everything. I wished we stayed longer. Simply wonderful! We loved everything about Cavallino. Wonderful.

Close to the downtown, really safe neighborhood, close to the grocery store, easy to get in and out the apartment, definitely would recommend to others and the price was fair. The halway that goes right into the street sidewalk had the door broken missing hardware lock and handles and I notified through whatsup Alessia office hopefully that will be fixed and a key provided for both apartments. Other than that everything was amazing.
Looked new and clean. Comfortable bed The shower leaked water all over the washroom floor. I had the shower door closed the duration of my shower. I cleaned it up
Very well-maintained apartment in a quiet, peaceful village. Great value.
Excellent location in Arabba, quiet, nice parking. Easy to walk after we leave the car at the B&B.
We appreciated access to a washing machine and kitchen.

I wouldve given this place an 8 but our host was incredible! This was the first destination of our trip so we arrived really late at 9pm and the host came to hand over the keys. There were a few things that bothered us, such as a gas stove alarm that kept going off even though gas was closed. Also, the safe never worked. A technician did come to fix it but it never worked. Also there were 2 doors outside of our apartment. 1 of them (the green one) didnt lock from the OUTSIDE.

Eugenio and Francesca were truly exceptional hosts! Warm, generous, and welcoming from the moment we arrived (even waiting up for us after a very late arrival). They made us feel like family. Breakfast was a real highlight, with fresh local Sardinian produce served with care. The room was spotless, peaceful, and the bed incredibly comfortable. This was an absolute highlight of our time in Sardinia. Their local tips also made a big difference to our trip. Nothing at all
1st of all thanks to Musta, the employee who greeted us. Location has so much potential. Needs a littlectender loving care.
The house was clean and spacious for 3 people, and Claudio the owner was super friendly and helpful. The running water is non potable so one has to purchase bottled water at local stores.
Breakfast was very good, good choice of food. Good, fast service in pleasant surroundings.

The rooms were very well appointed, the location was perfect, 10 walk to beach and a 15 drive to airport. The grounds were beautiful, and Paola was the best hostess. Would recommend this wonderful place.

am a regular guest

The hotel location is excellent; the room was comfortable and clean. Even though, I was travelling solo, the room was bigger than expected. Overall, it is a good option. Good bed and bathroom facilities. Breakfast was also comprehensive in options. Disturbed sleep because of some obscure alarm going off nearby during the night. Indifference to our complaint
Everything was comfortable There was a cobweb at the entrance and in the bathroom and a smell of sewage

The property was amazing very clean and extremely nice and relaxing. It is decorated with taste and luxury. The details enhance its charm and the host is an amazing guy who helped us in booking restaurants and everything we needed thank you Danilo.
Well placed hotel.short walk to private beach Breakfast amazing Nothing at all to not like

Staff of the afternoon shift were exceptionally helpful. Everyone was very attentive. Morning buffet was very good with lots of choices. Location of the hotel most difficult to find. Even local storekeepers had trouble identifying the location,

A great view of Mount Etna awaited us as we settle into our room, which also featured a walk-in closet and enormous bath. We found the hotel to be old school in a very pleasant way. It was a 20E taxi onto the centre of Taormina, or you could take the hotel shuttle, which required reservations and had limited frequency. We loved the beach and the bar up top. There was a convention in the hotel and I thought they did a great job of not inconveniencing other guests. The breakfast room was excellent and featured too many choices!

Very clean place, well located. Nice to have a coffee machine inside the room Too many keys for everything. Needs to first put the card in the room to have light in the separated bathroom. Does not make sense at all.

It was close to the airport. The staff was very helpful and got us an early morning taxi booked for our flight. They also had suggestions for dinner. The grounds and room looked lovely. The bed was squeaky. The air conditioner only goes while you're in the room. Big comfy bed, great location close to train station, beautifully decorated and clean. Throughly enjoyed our stay Just lift not working with luggage was a struggle, but looks like it’s being fixed
everything was wonderful host was great everything we wanted

The elevator didn't work we had to walk upstairs 4 levels wich was very difficult We are old people 70+years. elevator didn't work we very upset.

Excellent location. Excellent host and communication. Apartment a bit tight for a family of 4 including teenagers, but we were informed about that. Recommended for a short stay in Rome, close to most main attractions, very clean and fully equipped.
Quiet air conditioning, wonderful location, enjoyed Netflix, comfortable bed, easy entry.
comfortable, lovely decor, quiet rooms with clean bathroom. Early morning, had to contact host for coffee cups.
The location was good The check out time is too early, 10am
This was a nice place in a quiet neighborhood There was not a proper shower, just a bath tub with low ceiling

On pedestrian street, quiet and walking distance to everything. Large studio with very comfortable bed and beautiful bathroom with rain shower and hand held shower. Large mini fridge. Only 2 complimentary coffee pods for entire stay--should provide more or sell guests individual ones! Need more counter space and a sink in kitchen area to wash dishes--had to use sink in the washroom!

The breakfast was good -- a good choice of foods for everybody. I did not like the location. The hotel is located next to train tracks in a very uninteresting part of town. It is really just a place for a stopover on a long trip.
Lovely setting, spa facilities are amazing. Restaurant is very nice Breakfast service - no major complaints just a bit slow to bring coffee and options limited at the buffet
Near the public transportation and the Coliseum excellent location Everything was good

We booked this location last minute to be close to the ferry to cross to Sicily. Hotel was clean, comfortable, with lovely grounds, beautiful views and friendly, lovely staff. Would 100% book here again. Great value for the price.
View, it’s an all about!

When we arrived we were in a garden room. The garden room was very big but we really wanted the sea view. The hotel graciously found us a sea view room for the last two nights. Although the sea view room was much smaller but still lovely. The breakfast and outside and inside eating area were beautiful. It was a great breakfast. It was over and beyond what you would traditionally get. You could have eggs done as you wait. We have never stayed at a hotel that was soooo clean. It sparkled. The traditional decor style was designed in keeping with the area and nicely appointed. It was just a short walk to the down town area and tons of restaurants. Its a good 17 minute down hill walk to the ferry. Coming back from the Ferry is a very steep hill so keep some money for a taxi. Most taxis were 20 -25 euros so they are not cheap. We liked everything.

Hotel room was clean inside with decent air condition, went on very hot days so I was glad AC was good. Room was somewhat small but for the price is fairly good . Staff was excellent especially the Filipino lady server that works in breakfast time. Very friendly staff and gave us excellent service. Location was very near the main tourists site like the Doges Palace and Rialto Bridge. Main reason we book this was for the location and it did not disappoint. We were able to walk around and come back to rest then walk again on another site. Stairs, there's no elevators so be mindful when you're carrying heavy luggage because it is on the 3rd floor.
Truly amazing place, classic Italian family owned business and comes with the best nonna who personally bakes breakfast for guests in the morning, which alone is worth going there.
The responsiveness of the host was excellent and accessing the apartment was easy Free, secure parking was a plus. Walking distance to supermarket and Alghero's old town.
Very comfortable flat. Everything you needed. Even has a cool old elevator
It was very peaceful and quiet. I slept great.

Great location for all sites. Amazing staff; especially Peter, Elena and Ushani.
Very close to vatican
Best hospitality ever. Luigi is an expert on Rome and is the ultimate host.

We were traveling as a family of three adults and had just two nights and one full day in Rome. We arrived after midnight and the self check-in went smoothly. The location is good - close to a metro station and a short walk to Vatican City. The breakfast included a decent selection of sweet and savory options and the breakfast hours were very flexible. There was an elevator which was nice when moving our luggage in/out.
Wonderful location and nice pool. Very nice staff. Overall good experience but overpriced.

The property was in a great place, easily accessible with a short walk to everything. We, (especially me) liked the cave-like room. Also, Lorenzo was great. The shower is visible to the whole room, (which is a bit weird).

Breakfast was included with our stay and was prepared by a restaurant and caffe just below our accommodations. They were always prepared for us every morning, and everything was fresh. The rooms were of average hotel size, but very clean, and cleaned and madeup everyday, including clean towels and modern. Fresh fruit was left for us everyday, as well as water in mini fridge. The location was perfect for a home base. Walkable to train station, we took the train to Venice one day. Many shops, gelato, restaurants, caffes in area, all walkable, some places were closed to vehicle traffic. We were there for Wednesday market day. A public park close by for our grandchildren (our son, daughter in law and two young grandchildren stayed in Ex Casa degli Artisiti apartment, same building as us, our daughter had a room right next to us), we walked to a close by laundromat, dropped off by 9:00, washed and dried by noon, not expensive. We had a car rental from a place also in Montebelluna, parking was provided for us. Our host, Davide, (and his wife) was such a pleasure, always with a smile and a greeting, everyday. Asking us about our day and our family, with genuine interest. He provided information on anything we would ask.
great 👍 Everything

Nice place a bit distant from center, 15-20 minute walk. Cute and clean bed and breakfast. Friendly staff. Liked that there was a grocery store right up the street, very convenient. Breakfast included , but was lacking in options and repetitive . Expected fresher products and a bit more choice, coffee bar was serviced by a nice young man

Great location, spacious room with a nice view, host let us check out late and provided everything we needed Construction across the street but only noisy in the morning which isn't a big deal if you're an early bird

The breakfast was exceptional , every day Tomaso , our host, baked 2-3 traditionally cakes, different each day. The savory option of the breakfast was also very well presented , with good choices, and very good quality products. The home made yogurt and his mom's home made jams were outstanding. He took the time every every morning to great us before breakfast and introduce us everything he prepared for us for breakfast . The property is very large with olive trees , a small pond , a beautiful vegetable garden and small forest. The hosts encouraged us to explore the area. The countryside view and the landscape is very beautify and offers you a quiet and nice place to relax and recharge. Tomaso and his father Andrea were very welcoming, always willing to help and to make sure that we had a great time at their property. Although a bit secluded, the location offers you easy access to the historic towns and villages from that area. Tomaso also put a lot of effort in preparing and providing us a good list of places to visit, landscapes and restaurants from the area. Stayed to little , few more days in this place would been ideal.

beautiful large balcony, nice area for breakfast, staff was nice and communicated via whats app prior to arrival rooms are very small, might have more variety for breakfast (eg fruit salad) and proper coffee if there were umbrellas on the roof top deck that would have been amazing - the view from there was wonderful

My partner and I loved every part of our stay! From the warm welcome and pickup by the hosts to stepping into the pristine loft — where a bottle of bubbles awaited us — every detail made the experience extra special. The space was spotless and beautifully romantic; we truly felt pampered. The location is also fantastic, just a short walk to the heart of Stresa. Our hosts were incredibly accommodating and went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. Highly recommended! Nothing!
Beautiful apartment in an excellent location. The staff Aira and Mirko accommodating and helpful in everything! It was a perfect stay! Nothing!
Our stay was excellent. The host was always available to help. It was perfect for our first trip with our 10 month old daughter. Nothing

Hosts were very friendly and helpful. The room and bathroom were spacious. No street noise. Very good breakfast. Ideally situated between the train station and the historical centre. Could hear people going past in the hallway, little step in the bathroom
There was no breakfast. The heating didn't work so we were cold for the first two days. But I should have talked to the staff about this, so it's really my fault.

Our hostess left lots of milk, espresso and treats. Balcony was very useful. Shower hose was leaking water but did not affect performance.

Our host was very sweet and breakfast was awesome. The room was cute,comfortable and clean. Kettle didn't work and fridge noisy but a great stay, thankyou. Kettle didn't work and fridge noisy, we wish there was some seating outside. The courtyard pretty but not allowed to use it.

room was very ordinary..

This is not a fancy hotel but it was a good place to stay for a night, close to the airport. The staff were all very friendly and helpful. The hotel is clean and our room was comfortable. There are many lovely restaurants and a grocery store within a short walk. A wonderful Beach is about a 15 minute walk from the hotel. We loved the Beach . The water was calm, shallow and warm. With a lovely sandy beach. We went to one of the Beach clubs and rented 2 nice Beach loungers and an umbrella for the afternoon for about $ 20. The beach club had washrooms , showers and food available. It was a fantastic relaxing way to spend the last day of our wonderful but busy trip to Italy. The hotel has a very simple breakfast available with croissants, yogurt, coffee, Tea and juices. We were able to arrange a shuttle at the hotel desk . To the Airport from the hotel for 8 Euro per person. The hotel is only about a 15 minute drive from the airport but a TAXI cost 35 EURO to the hotel. There is a shuttle service from the airport but it was difficult to find the stop and the schedule at the airport . The Airport shuttle cost 8 to 10 Euro per person.

Great breakfast provided by Salvo, the owner. He was also very helpful, with lots of recommendations for the city and surrounding areas. Comfortable bed and lockers provided with locks. Great for a quick stay. No frills, but gets the job done for a decent price

the location, the terrace, the host was very friendly and responsive the mattress was a bit too hard, only one mirror in all the appartement

Perfect place both for rxploring Venice and airport transfer. Safe and quiet district with supermarkets and restaurants nearby, bus to Venice steps away, 15 minutes to Venice. Amazing location, excellent apartment.

Beautiful spacious hotel. Booked a room that was actually a suite. Very pleasantly surprised! Excellent mini-bar and possibility to make coffee in the room. Directly across from cruise dock a staff helped us to bring luggage to the dock. Breakfast was plentiful but not that tasty. Staff in the breakfast room didn't offer coffee.
We really enjoyed the stay in your accommodation. One back draw was on the first day to find the house number on the gate. Thank you . The home number could be more visible.
The apartment was spacious and pristine. It is centrally located right in the heart of old Orvieto. The host was very friendly, helpful and accommodating.

Nice room, cute balcony. Wifi was spotty, and the front reception not being available after 1pm wasn't great. While I'll recommend this place to other people, we probably won't stay here again as I'd prefer guest services to be around more.
Very comfortable apartment with everything what's required for vacation stay. Rooms are very well furnished and quite big. Highly recommended.

Large bed. Nicely decorated rooms included a bedroom and a front room. Fancy shower with multiple jets! Large bed. Well stocked fridge with free water. Wine and other drinks available at reasonable cost. A coffee machine and kettle with free coffee and tea provided. Breakfast at a nearby bar was fresh and generous. Safe parking for our bicycles. Verona is a lovely city to visit. Bathroom was quite tight. It seemed unnecessary to have a fee for parking our bicycles in the corner of the parking lot. I was disappointed to find that we were actually quite far away from the gardens that this hotel uses the name of Giardini Giusti; we had anticipated being right next to the gardens.
